def: a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person)

occurrences.text: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
